stem: Which of these ideas is reinforced throughout the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: The president's duties have not changed over the years.

options.label: B
options.text: Presidential advisers have the opportunity to work closely with the president.

options.label: C
options.text: The president's duties do not cease when he travels.

options.label: D
options.text: It takes the president more time to get work done while traveling than at home.
